name: Dr. R. Aishwariya
seoDescription: Dr. R. Aishwariya (BDS, MPH) is a public health researcher and dentist working in tobacco control, digital health, nutrition and implementation research, with projects funded by WHO, UNICEF, ICMR and the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare.
